decision.observed_event: The most this table plays is 25 gp a round, so the bet is 25 gp. You want in. Two ways to play a round: settle it with one check, or play it out as twenty-one (blackjack), closest to 21 without going over. The stake is your 25 gp. Which way?

improv_read.connection: The table caps bets at twenty-five; Uktarl takes the most he can.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit keeps the cap clear and in the fiction.

public_brief.objective: Take the biggest bet the table allows and get the round started.
public_brief.tactic: Admire the bet, cap it at twenty-five, and offer the two ways to play.
public_brief.visible_cue: The fourth player whistles; the dealer taps the table twice.
public_brief.player_opening: She chooses card by card or one check.
public_brief.kit_focus: Keep the cap clear and quick, then hand her the choice.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: admire the bravado, then cap it

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The fourth player whistles low through his painted teeth. The dealer only smiles and taps the table twice with one long nail.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Fifty! A generous heart. Alas, this humble table tops out at twenty-five a hand, or the dead grow jealous of the living. Twenty-five it is, then. Shall I deal it out card by card, or will you settle the round on a single test of nerve?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Twenty-five on the table. Card by card, or one check?
segments.reacts_to: card by card, or will you settle the round on a single test of nerve?
